com.git-pull.libtmux-mcp/capability.description: Run a shell command in a pane with your user's permissions. Runs one authored command in a trusted pane shell and waits for singular framed output and completion. Its two preflights refuse caller or attended panes and an effective cohort larger than one. Pre-existing exact-client-path, trap, eval, or exit functions are outside the supported boundary; marker display-message commands honor the trusted server's command aliases and hooks.

command.description: The shell command, run in the pane's interactive shell.

max_lines.description: Maximum output lines, keeping the newest. Defaults to 200.

pane_id.description: The pane to act on, such as %1. Every listing tool returns these.

suppress_history.description: Best-effort persistent history suppression. Defaults to true.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up. Defaults to 30.0.
